prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic luxury poolside fashion portrait with a playful retro summer styling.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman lounging on a sunbed, wearing a pink cherry tube top, colorful crochet mini skirt, bold bangles, sunglasses, and red lipstick. Preserve relaxed confident editorial posture.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly low fashion-editorial angle, moderate depth of field, sunbed beside a luxury resort pool, palm trees, white umbrellas, clear blue sky, and strong summer vacation context.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright midday natural sunlight, vivid but natural color, playful chic summer glamour, crisp fabric and accessory detail.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens, sharp high-resolution editorial photography, photorealistic skin and crochet texture, moderate depth of field, natural poolside perspective.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Stylish poolside scene with an adult blonde woman lounging on a sunbed at a luxury resort. She wears a pink cherry tube top, colorful crochet mini skirt, bold bangles, sunglasses, and red lipstick. Palm trees, white umbrellas, clear blue sky, and bright midday natural daylight create a playful retro summer-vacation aesthetic. Slightly low fashion-editorial angle, 50mm lens, moderate depth of field, sharp high-resolution photorealistic photography, chic summer glamour.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, blurry, dull colors, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, cartoon, illustration, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, watermark, unwanted text

assets.name: blonde adult retro-fashion subject
assets.usage: Preserve approved adult identity, hair, sunglasses, lipstick, and lounge pose; replaceable with another approved adult.

assets.usage: Keep cherry motif, pink tone, crochet colors, bangles, and sunglasses consistent; replaceable with equivalent retro styling.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the matching preview for adult identity, outfit, props, and poolside hierarchy. Preserve face, hair, retro styling, lighting, and 50mm composition. Replacement assets must remain equivalent and non-branded; no typography is needed.
